skills.mechanics: 0-Ki Power Up Super from PQ61. Activating the pose temporarily reduces incoming damage for the documented 20-second duration. Current dedicated evidence does not establish the exact damage-reduction percentage or frame data.

300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate learned through Bardock training. It is a pseudo-Strike sequence that begins with a rushing punch and follows with a beam, dealing source-reported 35% total damage over 20 hits. Current evidence notes its chase has greater range than Saiyan Spirit and can track behind the user.

100-Ki Ki Blast Super from PQ113. The user creates five Buu-shaped ghosts; a second input commands them to attack, while leaving them for about five seconds also causes the attack. Current dedicated evidence reports five hits and about 5% total damage.

100-Ki Strike Super from PQ179. The user charges a heavy downward strike with super armor; continued melee attacks during the charge are absorbed/rebuffed, increasing the blow's strength, and the fully charged attack can guard-break the attacker and enable a follow-up Ultimate. Current evidence does not establish exact charge frames or damage scaling.

100-Ki Strike Super learned from Android 16. The user shoulder-charges for source-reported 10% damage and knockback; after a successful knockback it can be used as a chase and teleports to the opponent before the hit.

100-Ki Ki Blast Super learned through Bojack training. The barrage deals source-reported 5% over 10 hits and tracks at long range; an additional input before release cancels the move, functioning as a feint. Ki is spent when the blast actually fires.

100-Ki Ki Blast Super from Expert Mission 3. A thrown Ki ball erupts into a pillar on impact for source-reported 10% damage; directional input changes its travel distance, with up roughly doubling and down roughly halving the documented baseline throw distance.
300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from PQ46. The user throws five Destructo-Discs in sequence for source-reported 40% total damage across five hits; the discs are unblockable and launch the opponent.

selection_basis: Lowest combined mechanics/notes coverage after excluding every registered current-evidence audit.
evidence_policy: Use source-reported values as bounded evidence.
Do not infer unsupported frames, hidden gates, probabilities, or patch-independent scaling.
